reconstruction_preimage_family.description: Registry for classifying families of preimages associated with specific reconstruction outcomes.

family_classes.name: locally_unique_family
family_classes.description: Preimage set consists of a single point (strict recoverability).

family_classes.name: discrete_branch_family
family_classes.description: Preimage set consists of N discrete symmetric branches (delta multiplicity).

family_classes.name: manifold_fiber_family
family_classes.description: Preimage set is a continuous manifold or fiber (projection loss).

family_classes.name: asymptotic_state_family
family_classes.description: Preimage set expands to the full admissible state space (asymptotic failure).
